purpose: Resolve point-in-time E-layer eligibility from a sparse append-only ledger of ratified effective positive events instead of materializing daily full-market E-layer snapshots.

problem_elimination.delete: No daily full-market eligibility snapshot files.
problem_elimination.avoid: Do not recompute issuer classifications for every signal date.
problem_elimination.absorb: Use ratified prospective positive events and the frozen effective-date rule.
problem_elimination.substitute: Default every security/date to NOT_ESTABLISHED unless an effective positive event exists.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Persist one compact effective event row and reuse it for all later signal dates.
problem_elimination.optimize: Index/query only by canonical_security_id and effective_signal_date.

state_resolution.rule: For canonical security S on signal date D, return ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE iff at least one ratified event for S has effective_signal_date <= D; otherwise return NOT_ESTABLISHED.
state_resolution.multiple_positive_events: Earliest effective positive event is sufficient; later positive events do not move eligibility backward.
state_resolution.signal_date_scope: Must be a frozen joint A-share trading date in the V2.7.32 calendar.
